entries.symptom: Plural forms wrong, Intl.PluralRules or Intl.Locale undefined, -u-nu- digits ignored, or dates in an unexpected calendar on the device while Jest passes
entries.cause: Hermes implements only part of Intl natively (no PluralRules or Locale on some builds), drops the numbering system, and some locales (fa) default to a non-Gregorian calendar
entries.fix: Load the FormatJS polyfills (getcanonicallocales, locale, pluralrules, numberformat with the app's locale data) first in the entry and in Jest; format at the edge through react-intl; pass an explicit calendar (-u-ca-gregory) where the product needs one

entries.symptom: A date or number shows in the device's language instead of the language chosen in the app
entries.cause: toLocaleDateString() / toLocaleString() without a locale argument format in the device locale
entries.fix: Format through react-intl (formatDate, formatNumber) with the app's current locale; never call toLocale* without arguments in app code

entries.symptom: eslint-plugin-formatjs never reports ICU problems in the catalogs
entries.cause: Its content rules skip calls without defaultMessage, and the messages live only in JSON catalogs
entries.fix: Register the app's translate helpers in settings.formatjs and run the catalog checker plus formatjs verify --structural-equality

entries.cause: idInterpolationPattern requires defaultMessage and hashed ids, which conflicts with semantic keys
entries.fix: Use enforce-id without the pattern, or drop the rule

entries.symptom: A usage-description text (Info.plist, InfoPlist.strings) shows a literal {placeholder} in the system dialog
entries.cause: iOS shows usage strings straight from Info.plist, where nothing formats ICU
entries.fix: Write system texts as plain sentences without braces (iOS already names the app in the dialog title)

entries.symptom: A <lang>.lproj/InfoPlist.strings has no translation for a usage description, so the system dialog shows English
entries.cause: The catalogs lack the system text the config plugin writes into each language
entries.fix: Add the key to every catalog, then prebuild again; the privacy and release gates check every language

entries.symptom: A date inside a sentence shows its parts in the wrong order in an RTL language
entries.cause: A text that already carries bidi isolates (FSI ... PDI) was passed into another message as a value, which isolates it again
entries.fix: Strip the inner isolates before passing it (stripIsolates), so the sentence holds one isolate per value

entries.symptom: Text stays left-aligned in an RTL layout, or right-aligned text lands on the left
entries.cause: textAlign 'auto' stays physical left on iOS unless the app language itself is RTL, and 'left'/'right' are swapped to start/end in RTL
entries.fix: Align through the text primitive (AppText align start/end) with writingDirection set; never 'right' for Arabic

entries.cause: I18nManager changes apply on the next JS load
entries.fix: Change direction only through the direction module: record the pending direction, allowRTL and forceRTL together, save state first, then reloadAppAsync() from expo (Updates.reloadAsync rejects where expo-updates is disabled, as in development builds)

entries.symptom: Data is written twice on a direction switch
entries.cause: Module-level and startup code run once before the reload and once after it
entries.fix: Run the direction check first at startup, before any write, and reload only from a mounted component

entries.symptom: Direction flips back or disagrees with the saved language
entries.cause: I18nManager.isRTL is captured at JS load and persists natively (it can drift after a device restore)
entries.fix: Compute the desired direction from the saved language, correct drift at startup, and read the layout direction from I18nManager

entries.symptom: The app follows the device language for direction and undoes the in-app language choice at every launch
entries.cause: expo-localization's supportsRTL / forcesRTL plugin options re-apply direction from the device language at every module creation
entries.fix: Give expo-localization supportedLocales only; never forcesRTL; supportsRTL only for an app without its own language choice

entries.symptom: A consent form or purchase sheet shows the device language, not the language chosen in the app
entries.cause: Google UMP and the store sheets follow the device or per-app system language
entries.fix: Expected: nothing to fix in app code; say so in the release notes for testers

entries.symptom: RTL behaviour changes after an SDK upgrade
entries.cause: Expo's localization guide announces RTL default changes for SDK 58
entries.fix: Rerun the RTL screenshots and the direction tests after the upgrade

entries.symptom: A language is not detected on a real device
entries.cause: Devices report some languages under several codes (ckb or ku-Arab; zh-Hant-TW or zh-TW)
entries.fix: Resolve the device locale through a mapping that accepts each known form, with a test per form

entries.cause: The font lacks FSI U+2068 / PDI U+2069
entries.fix: Check each new font for the isolate characters, or pick one that draws them invisibly

entries.symptom: Marks or digit tops of Arabic-script text are clipped
entries.cause: Arabic-script fonts need more line height, and iOS clips a Text at its frame while browsers let it overflow
entries.fix: Give Arabic-script text about 1.5x line height in the type scale (the text primitive applies it per script); check in screenshots

entries.symptom: A character renders as tofu in one language
entries.cause: The font lacks the glyph (letter-like marks, rare capitals, tabular digits)
entries.fix: Check every font against the catalogs, avoid those characters, or add a fallback font

entries.symptom: Every screen renders in the system font; the design fonts never appear
entries.cause: The expo-font plugin entry embeds only some of the font files
entries.fix: One expo-font plugin entry that embeds every font file the theme names; prebuild with --clean
